killings.evidence: Í því hjó Önundur á öxlina svo að af tók höndina. ... Vígbjóður var þá kominn að bana.
killings.relation_detail: Hebridean viking vs Norwegian settler; no kin.
killings.feud_name: Önundur & Þrándur vs the vikings Vígbjóður & Vestmar
killings.note: Sea battle at Bót; Vígbjóður dies of the arm wound (verse over the dying man).

killings.evidence: hófust deilur þeirra Ófeigs grettis og Þorbjarnar laxakappa og lauk svo að Ófeigur féll fyrir Þorbirni í Grettisgeil
killings.relation_detail: Þorbjörn's wife Una Steinólfsdóttir is a first cousin of Ófeigur (both grandchildren of Ölvir barnakarl); spouse's cousin = beyond affinity rule.
killings.feud_name: Þorbjörn laxakappi vs Ófeigur grettir (Grettisgeil)
killings.note: Killer also called laxakarl (ch3) and jarlakappi (ch10). Victim is Önundur tréfótur's father-in-law, distinct from his grandson Ófeigur grettir Önundarson (KN120). Brief narrative statement.

killings.evidence: Þorgeir mælti: "Þar færi eg þér öxi þína." Síðan hjó hann á hálsinn svo að af tók höfuðið.
killings.relation_detail: Þorfinnur was Flosi's housecarl who had attempted to kill Þorgeir (ch11).
killings.feud_name: Kaldbeklingar vs Flosi of Árnes (whale at Rifsker)
killings.avenges_person: Þorgeir Önundarson himself (Þorfinnur's attempt on his life, ch11)
killings.note: Þorfinnur declared ógildur at the settlement. Fight arose over a beached whale (property).

killings.evidence: Ólafur hjó til Ófeigs grettis og særði hann til ólífis.
killings.relation_detail: Ólafur of Drangar is a kinsman of Flosi; no tie to the Kaldbak brothers stated.
killings.feud_name: Kaldbeklingar vs Flosi of Árnes (whale at Rifsker)
killings.note: 'Særði til ólífis' (mortally wounded); 'Ófeigur var bættur miklu fé' at settlement. Death not explicitly narrated.

killings.evidence: Og í því hjó Grettir til Hjarranda og kom á höndina uppi við öxl svo af tók.
killings.relation_detail: Hjarrandi is brother of Björn (KL123), whom Grettir killed.
killings.note: Hjarrandi ambushed Grettir to avenge Björn; jarl later says Grettir 'hefir nú drepið þrjá bræður' (ch24), confirming death.

killings.evidence: Grettir hjó þá niður í milli Gunnars og skjaldarins og af honum báðar hendurnar ... Grettir hjó hann banahögg
killings.relation_detail: Gunnar is brother of Björn and Hjarrandi.
killings.note: Gunnar attacked Grettir in a booth to avenge his brothers. Byname added to distinguish from Gunnar Þórisson (KN124).

killings.evidence: sá varð endir á að Þorgils féll dauður fyrir Þorgeiri til jarðar.
killings.relation_detail: Þorgils was a close kinsman of Ásmundur hærulangur.
killings.note: Retelling (citing Þormóður's erfidrápa) of the whale-fight killing narrated in Fóstbræðra saga ch7 (KL176, Þorgils Mársson). Same killing.

killings.evidence: Og þegar hjó hann annað högg svo að það varð að banasári.
killings.relation_detail: Gunnar and Þorgeir Þórissynir of Skarð were allies of Þorbjörn öxnamegin.
killings.note: Þórissynir ambushed Atli at Þorbjörn öxnamegin's urging.

killings.evidence: Þá hjó Grímur með öxi milli herða honum svo stóð á kafi.
killings.relation_detail: Grímur is brother of Gamli, husband of Atli's sister Rannveig; no tie to victim.
killings.note: Þorgeir was fleeing after his brother fell; killing settled at Húnavatnsþing (ch44).

killings.evidence: fékk Grettir tekið það og hafði ekki orða við hann og hjó þegar höfuð af honum og lauk svo hans ævi.
killings.relation_detail: Outlaw hired by Þórir í Garði to kill Grettir.
killings.feud_name: Þórir í Garði's hired outlaw Rauðskeggur vs Grettir
killings.note: Rauðskeggur attacked Grettir with his own sword.

killings.evidence: Hljóp hann þá að Steinólfi úr Hraundal og hjó til hans í höfuðið og klauf hann í herðar niður
killings.relation_detail: Steinólfur of Hraundalur was in the Mýramenn posse.
killings.feud_name: Grettir vs Mýramenn at Grettisoddi
killings.note: Verse: 'Steinólfs höfuðskeina' cannot be healed; five men fell.

killings.evidence: þegar annað högg hjó hann til Þorgils Ingjaldssonar og kom á hann miðjan og tók nálega í sundur.
killings.relation_detail: Þorgils was nephew of Þórður Kolbeinsson; no tie to Grettir.
killings.feud_name: Grettir vs Mýramenn at Grettisoddi
killings.note: Verse confirms death: 'Því er um Þorgils ævi þung von'.

killings.evidence: Grettir hjó með saxinu til Víkars fylgdarmanns Hjalta Þórðarsonar ... og tók þar sundur þvert manninn
killings.relation_detail: Víkar was a follower of Hjalti Þórðarson in Öngull's party.
killings.note: Same fight: Grettir also spears Kár, heimamaður of Halldór frá Hofi ('stóð þegar í gegnum hann'), which is not in the dataset.

killings.evidence: Leiddu þeir hann þá er lýsti austur á eyna og hjuggu hann þá
killings.relation_detail: Illugi was Grettir's brother; no tie to Öngull.
killings.note: Öngull led the raid and decided Illugi's execution after he refused an oath not to take revenge; the blow is given by 'þeir' (unnamed).

killings.evidence: Tók Drómundur nú við saxinu ... og hjó til Önguls. ... Féll Þorbjörn öngull ærulaus dauður til jarðar.
killings.relation_detail: Þorsteinn is Grettir's paternal half-brother; no tie to Öngull.
killings.note: In Constantinople; Þorsteinn says he is Grettir's brother and has now achieved his revenge.

killings.evidence: Gísli bjóst til hólmgöngu og berjast þeir og lýkur svo að Björn fellur.
killings.relation_detail: Björn blakki, berserk, had just killed Gísli's brother Ari in a holmgang.
killings.note: Gísli (uncle of Gísli Súrsson) takes the holmgang to stop Björn taking Ari's land and wife; then marries Ari's widow Ingibjörg.

killings.evidence: Gísli heggur í móti með Grásíðu í höfuð þrælnum svo fast að sverðið brotnaði en hausinn lamdist og fær hvortveggji bana.
killings.relation_detail: Kolur was the thrall of Gísli's wife Ingibjörg (master-slave household).
killings.feud_name: Gísli Þorkelsson vs the thrall Kolur (Grásíða)
killings.note: Mutual killing over the sword Grásíða; the reverse event Kolur > Gísli Þorkelsson is not in the dataset.

killings.evidence: þá er minnst von var heggur Gísli Bárð banahögg.
killings.relation_detail: Bárður was said to be seducing Gísli's sister Þórdís; friend of Gísli's brother Þorkell.
killings.feud_name: Súrnadalur feud: Gísli vs Bárður's kin (Hólmgöngu-Skeggi, Kolbjörn, Skeggjasynir)
killings.note: Killed for dishonouring Þórdís; father Þorbjörn approved.

killings.evidence: koma á óvart til Kolbjarnar og brenna hann inni við tólfta mann
killings.relation_detail: Kolbjörn, Þórdís's other suitor, had joined the Skeggjasynir in burning Stokkar.
killings.feud_name: Súrnadalur feud: Gísli vs Bárður's kin (Hólmgöngu-Skeggi, Kolbjörn, Skeggjasynir)
killings.avenges_person: Þorbjörn súr's family (burning of Stokkar, 12 men burned)
killings.note: Burning led by 'þau Gísli' with 40 men from Friðarey; Gísli is the named leader (Þorkell may also have led).

killings.evidence: Gísli hjó þá höfuð af Hólmgöngu-Skeggja því að hann var þá þar hjá sonum sínum.
killings.relation_detail: Skeggi was close kin of Bárður and had sought Þórdís in marriage.
killings.feud_name: Súrnadalur feud: Gísli vs Bárður's kin (Hólmgöngu-Skeggi, Kolbjörn, Skeggjasynir)
killings.avenges_person: Þorbjörn súr's family (burning of Stokkar by Skeggi's sons)
killings.note: Skeggi's sons Einar and Árni had led the burning; they were killed just before (Gísli killed three, Þorkell two, not individually named).

killings.evidence: En Þorgrímur leggur á honum með spjóti og vegur hann.
killings.relation_detail: Norwegian merchant; no kin.
killings.feud_name: Þorgrímur vs the Austmen Þórir and Þórarinn
killings.note: The Austmen had killed Þorgrímur's son Þóroddur over a timber deal; Þorgrímur also kills Þórir (not in dataset).

killings.evidence: fer Gísli heiman og kemur á Nefsstaði og tekur Þorgrím nef höndum ... og er barður grjóti til bana
killings.relation_detail: Sorcerer bribed by Börkur to work seiðr against Þorgrímur's killer (Gísli).
killings.avenges_person: Gísli himself (Þorgrímur nef's seiðr against him)
killings.note: Gísli seizes him and has him stoned to death (passive voice); Gísli present and leading.

killings.evidence: Þorgrímur Austmaður skýtur eftir honum spjóti og kemur milli herða honum ... og var það hans banasár.
killings.relation_detail: Þórður was Gísli's thrall, wearing Gísli's cloak; killer was in Börkur's party.
killings.note: Mistaken for Gísli during Börkur's prosecution trip. In the same chapter Gísli kills Þóroddur and Þorgrímur Austmaður (not in dataset).

killings.evidence: stendur Gísli fyrir með brugðið sverð og keyrir þegar í höfuð honum svo að stóð í herðum niðri og féll hann dauður
killings.relation_detail: Saka-Steinn is a sister's son of Börkur, who married Gísli's sister Þórdís; chain too long.

killings.evidence: reiðir upp sverðið og rekur á lendarnar svo að í sundur tók manninn í miðju
killings.relation_detail: Follower of Eyjólfur grái.
killings.note: Final attack on outlaw Gísli.

killings.evidence: keyrir sverðið í höfuð Þórði, frænda Eyjólfs, og klýfur hann allt til beltisstaðar
killings.relation_detail: Kinsman of Eyjólfur grái.
killings.note: Gísli's last blow; he also kills Sveinn and others (unnamed/one named Sveinn not in dataset).

killings.evidence: Leggja þeir þá til hans með spjótum svo að út falla iðrin ... Lýkur þar nú ævi Gísla
killings.relation_detail: Eyjólfur was hired by Börkur for 300 silver; no kin.
killings.note: Eyjólfur led the attack; mortal spear-thrusts by 'þeir Eyjólfur og frændur hans'. This is the primary narration; KL169 (eyrbyggja_saga) is the same killing and looks like the passing reference.

killings.evidence: En sá er í skarlatsklæðunum var brá sverði og hjó Berg banahögg. Það var Ari Súrsson, bróðir Gísla og Þorkels.
killings.relation_detail: Bergur is son of Vésteinn, brother of Gísli's wife Auður; chain too long.
killings.note: In Norway; Bergur names himself and his kin before Ari strikes.

killings.evidence: finnur eigi fyrr en Þorgeir hjó framan í fang honum og þar á hol. Fellur hann á bak aftur.
killings.relation_detail: Butraldi was a kinsman and friend of Vermundur, Þorgeir's enemy.
killings.feud_name: Þorgeir vs Butraldi (Vermundur's kinsman)
killings.note: Taunt 'Rann kappinn nú?'; companions dare not avenge him.

killings.evidence: Þorgeir leggur spjótinu til hans og þegar í gegnum svo að hann féll þegar dauður af baki.
killings.relation_detail: Bjarni, son of Skúfur in Hundadalur, had taken Þorgeir's horse.
killings.feud_name: Killings in Hundadalur (Bjarni and Skúfur)
killings.note: Primary narration. KL127 (grettis_saga ch27) is a one-line passing reference to this killing and should probably be its cross_saga_duplicate.

killings.evidence: hann hjó til Skúfs hinni hægri hendi með exinni í höfuðið og klauf í herðar niður og dó hann þegar.
killings.relation_detail: Shepherd of Skúfur in Hundadalur.
killings.feud_name: Killings in Hundadalur (Bjarni and Skúfur)
killings.note: Shepherd attacked Þorgeir after Bjarni fell. KL126 (grettis_saga ch27) is a passing reference to this killing.

killings.evidence: hjó þegar í höfuð Snorra svo hart að hann klýfur hausinn allan. Fær Snorri af því sári þegar bana.
killings.relation_detail: Farmer at Hvítstaðir; no kin.
killings.feud_name: Þorgeir vs Hækil-Snorri at Hvítstaðir
killings.note: Snorri wounded Þorgeir's packhorses in his hayfield. Þorgeir also kills Snorri's two unnamed housecarls.

killings.evidence: leggur Þorgeir spjótinu til Þóris. Það lag kom framan í fang honum og gekk þar á hol. Féll Þórir inn í dyrnar og dauður.
killings.relation_detail: No kin.
killings.feud_name: Þorgeir kills Þórir á Hrófá on King Ólafur's behalf
killings.avenges_person: King Ólafur's hirðmaður (unnamed, wounded by Þórir)
killings.avenger_relation: fellow royal retainer acting on the king's commission
killings.note: King Ólafur ordered the revenge but was absent, so Þorgeir is the killer. The avenged man was wounded, not killed.

killings.evidence: þeir Þórarinn og Þorgrímur stóðu nær og unnu þeir þá á Þorgeiri og við það féll hann ... Þórarinn ofsi hjó höfuð af Þorgeiri
killings.relation_detail: No kin.
killings.note: Joint killing with Þorgrímur trölli (KN238); both struck Þorgeir down.

killings.evidence: þeir Þórarinn og Þorgrímur stóðu nær og unnu þeir þá á Þorgeiri og við það féll hann og lét líf sitt.
killings.relation_detail: No kin.
killings.avenger_relation: ship partner of Þórarinn ofsi, Gautur's kinsman
killings.note: Þorgrímur trölli Einarsson (existing person 'Þorgrímur', later killed by Þormóður, KL181) promised Þórarinn help with the revenge.

killings.evidence: Hann hjó á hönd Þorgeiri og er hann hafði það sár fengið þá hjó hann Má banahögg.
killings.relation_detail: Austmaður in Þorgrímur and Þórarinn's ship company.
killings.note: Distinct from Þórir austmaður (KL179).

killings.evidence: snarar Þormóður að Þorkatli og höggur báðum höndum í höfuð Þorkatli og klýfur hausinn. Fékk hann þegar bana.
killings.relation_detail: Þorkell is a sister's son of Þorgrímur trölli, one of Þorgeir's killers.
killings.note: Part of Þormóður's revenge for Þorgeir in Greenland. Brother Falgeir drowns grappling with Þormóður (not a weapon killing).

killings.evidence: Þá hjó Þormóður meðal herða honum svo að öxin sökk að skafti.
killings.relation_detail: Þórður is a sister's son of Þorgrímur trölli.
killings.note: Counted among the 'þrír kappar' killed that evening (Skúfur's remark).

killings.evidence: Þeir leggja þegar að Ljóti og berjast. Lýkur svo þessum fundi að Ljótur fellur
killings.relation_detail: Ljótur is a sister's son of Þorgrímur trölli.
killings.note: Joint attack by Þormóður and Gestur (Helgu-Steinar); the blow is not assigned. Ljótur had wounded Þormóður earlier (ch30).

killings.evidence: Þeir leggja þegar að Ljóti og berjast. Lýkur svo þessum fundi að Ljótur fellur
killings.relation_detail: No kin.
killings.avenger_relation: none stated (came to Greenland to avenge Þorgeir)
killings.note: Steinar went to Greenland under the name Gestur 'að hefna Þorgeirs Hávarssonar' (ch31).

killings.evidence: Þeir gengu á hólm í Álftafirði og féll Úlfar en Þórólfur varð sár á fæti
killings.relation_detail: No kin.
killings.feud_name: Þórólfur bægifótur takes Úlfar kappi's land by holmgang
killings.note: Þórólfur challenged the old childless Úlfar for his land and took it.

killings.evidence: fór vestur um fjörð að drepa Þorbjörn kjálka ... en þó varð Styr banamaður Þorbjarnar kjálka.
killings.relation_detail: No kin stated.
killings.feud_name: Víga-Styr kills Þorbjörn kjálki
killings.note: Brief; the berserks broke open his lock-bed, Styr struck. Reason not given.

killings.evidence: Þeir komu að þeim Vigfúsi óvörum og drápu Vigfús en gáfu grið húskörlum hans.
killings.relation_detail: Vigfús Bjarnarson's wife Þorgerður is a niece of Arnkell; no tie to Snorri.
killings.feud_name: Vigfús's assassination attempt on Snorri goði
killings.avenges_person: Snorri goði himself (Vigfús sent the thrall Svartur to kill him)
killings.note: Snorri led seven men; the blow is not assigned. Verse: 'Felldi fólksvaldi ... Vigfús'.

killings.evidence: Fékk Halli brotið hlemminn og komst upp og féll á húðinni. Veitti Styr honum á banasár.
killings.relation_detail: Halli was Styr's retainer, suing for his daughter Ásdís.
killings.feud_name: Víga-Styr kills the berserks in the bath-house
killings.note: Swedish berserk but human; same household as followers of Styr.

killings.evidence: En er Leiknir vildi hlaupa upp úr dyrunum lagði Styr í gegnum hann og féll hann inn í baðstofuna og lést þar.
killings.relation_detail: Leiknir, brother of Halli, was Styr's retainer.
killings.feud_name: Víga-Styr kills the berserks in the bath-house
killings.note: Killed with his brother to end Halli's suit for Ásdís.

killings.evidence: fékk Arnkell hana tekið og setti í höfuð Þorleifi og veitti honum banasár.
killings.relation_detail: Eastfjord outlaw; no kin.
killings.note: Þorleifur attacked Arnkell with an axe; rumoured to be sent by Snorri goði (hence F3). Not Þorleifur kimbi.

killings.evidence: svo lauk þeirra skiptum að Steinþór kom sverðshöggi á Freystein fyrir ofan mjaðmir og tók manninn í sundur í miðju.
killings.relation_detail: Freysteinn was Þorbrandur's foster-son (reputed son); no tie to Steinþór.
killings.note: Fight on the ice at Vigrafjörður between Steinþór of Eyri's men and the Þorbrandssynir, an outgrowth of the Arnkell/Snorri feud; Freysteinn attacked Steinþór.

killings.evidence: hjó á höndina Hrafni uppi við öxlina og tók þar af höndina. ... Þeir létust þegar báðir, Óspakur og Hrafn
killings.relation_detail: Follower of Snorri goði vs viking in Óspakur's band.
killings.feud_name: Snorri goði and Sturla vs Óspakur Kjallaksson's raiding band
killings.note: Suppression of a raiding band at its fort in Bitra; Hrafn dies of the wound.

killings.evidence: skaut Sturla snærispjóti til hans. Það kom á hann miðjan og féll hann út af virkinu.
killings.relation_detail: No kin.
killings.feud_name: Snorri goði and Sturla vs Óspakur Kjallaksson's raiding band
killings.note: Sturla wants it said that he alone was Óspakur's banamaður.

killings.evidence: lauk svo með þeim að kappinn féll fyrir Birni og fékk bana
killings.relation_detail: Kaldimar was a close kinsman of King Valdimar; Björn fought as the king's champion.
killings.feud_name: Björn's duel with Kaldimar in Garðaríki
killings.note: Single combat deciding a war over the kingdom of Garðaríki.

killings.evidence: Björn kastaði skildinum frá sér á hraunið og hjó til Eyvindar og var það banahögg
killings.relation_detail: Eyvindur and Óttar were Norwegian paternal kinsmen of Þórður Kolbeinsson.
killings.note: Ambush in Beruvíkurhraun. Brother Óttar also fell but his killer is not stated.

killings.evidence: Björn mælti: "Eigi mun eg yfir öðrum konungur ef eg er eigi yfir þér," og hjó hann banahögg.
killings.relation_detail: No kin.
killings.note: Þorkell recited Þórður's insulting Kolluvísur in Björn's hearing; Björn's plea at the Thing is that the reciter would fall óheilagur.

killings.evidence: Björn tók spjótið og skaut yfir ána ... og tók Kolbein Þórðarson er sat að baki honum og höfðu báðir bana.
killings.relation_detail: Kolbeinn is the son of Björn's enemy Þórður Kolbeinsson.
killings.note: Returned spear also kills an unnamed man.

killings.evidence: Björn tók spjótið á lofti og sendi aftur til eiganda. Það kom á Þorvald miðjan og féll hann dauður til jarðar.
killings.relation_detail: Son of Eiður; allied with Þórður.
killings.note: Final ambush on Björn at Hvítingshjalli.

killings.evidence: Þá þreif Björn sporð skjaldarins hinni hendinni og rak í höfuð Þórði svo að hann fékk þegar bana.
killings.relation_detail: Son of Eiður.
killings.note: Variant: some say he stabbed him with the shears.

killings.evidence: Þórður veikst undan en fyrir varð húskarl Þórðar er Grímur hét og fékk þegar bana.
killings.relation_detail: Housecarl of Þórður Kolbeinsson.
killings.note: Grímur took the blow meant for Þórður.

killings.evidence: Þórður vill þá eigi láta höggva á milli og höggur af Birni höfuð í öðru höggi
killings.relation_detail: Rivals over Oddný, Björn's betrothed whom Þórður married; no kin.
killings.note: Kálfur dealt Björn a great wound first; Þórður dealt the final blows. Climax of a long rivalry; Dálkur also seeks revenge for his son.

killings.evidence: Og er Hrolleifur sá hann skaut hann til hans spjóti og kom á hann miðjan.
killings.relation_detail: Ingimundur had taken Hrolleifur in and given him land; protector, not kin or household.
killings.feud_name: Ingimundarsynir vs Hrolleifur (killing of Ingimundur)
killings.note: Dispute over fishing in Vatnsdalsá; Ingimundur dies at home in his high seat.

killings.evidence: Jökull svarar: "Þess er eg nú albúinn." Hjó hann þá af honum höfuðið og bað hann aldrei þrífast.
killings.relation_detail: No kin.
killings.feud_name: Ingimundarsynir vs Hrolleifur (killing of Ingimundur)
killings.note: Not the Jökull of KL092 (a forest robber in Gautland).

killings.evidence: Jökull kom þá að honum og kvað hann vera mikla mannfýlu og illmenni ... Jökull hjó hann þá banahögg.
killings.relation_detail: No kin.
killings.feud_name: Ingimundarsynir vs Þórólfur sleggja
killings.note: Thief and sacrificer (also called heljarskinn) removed at the district's request ('héraðsbót').

killings.evidence: Guðbrandur skaut eftir honum sverði og kom á hann miðjan. ... og var hann þá dauður.
killings.relation_detail: Outlaw sent by Óttar to kill Ingólfur or Guðbrandur.
killings.feud_name: Ingimundarsynir (Ingólfur, Guðbrandur) vs Óttar over Valgerður
killings.note: Þórir had just attacked Guðbrandur with an axe; Óttar (absent) paid compensation, Þórir ógildur.

killings.evidence: lagði Svartur Guðbrand með spjótinu undir hendina og þegar á hol.
killings.relation_detail: Hired by Óttar; Guðbrandur had taken him into his household for the winter.
killings.feud_name: Ingimundarsynir (Ingólfur, Guðbrandur) vs Óttar over Valgerður
killings.note: Hired killing on Óttar's behalf (Óttar absent), underlying cause Ingólfur's visits to Óttar's daughter Valgerður. Mutual killing: Guðbrandur cut Svartur in two (not in dataset). same_group yes because Svartur was living in Guðbrandur's household.

killings.evidence: skaut Helgi Droplaugarson til hans milli fótanna og í gegnum kyllinn og féll hann á bak aftur
killings.relation_detail: Spy of Helgi Ásbjarnarson.
killings.note: He hangs on the spear in the snowdrift all day; counted among the five dead of Helgi Ásbjarnarson's side (death implied).

killings.evidence: Áttust þeir við og féll Kári en Helgi varð sár mjög.
killings.relation_detail: Kári, brother of Hjarrandi and mágur of Helgi Ásbjarnarson; Helgi magri was with the Droplaugarsons.
killings.note: Kári carried home on shields and a mound raised over him.

killings.evidence: Það varð þá úrræði Össurar að hann lagði á Helga Droplaugarsyni spjótinu svo að stóð í gegnum hann.
killings.relation_detail: Össur had poured the naming water over Helgi as an infant ('þú jóst mig vatni') — a ritual tie, not counted as fosterage.
killings.note: Össur had refused to fight Helgi but speared him when Helgi came at him.

killings.evidence: hjó með hinni hægri til Gauss og af fótinn fyrir ofan kné. ... Nú féll Gaus
killings.relation_detail: No kin.
killings.feud_name: Grímur vs the viking Gaus (holmgang in Norway)
killings.note: Holmgang: Finngeir offered his sister to whoever killed Gaus, who had sought her. Gaus could blunt blades but is human. His mistress Gefjun later avenges him.

killings.evidence: Eftir þetta hjó Helgi hann banahögg.
killings.relation_detail: No kin.
killings.note: Svartur had been outlawed (on Brodd-Helgi's prosecution) for killing Skíði and was stealing Hof's sheep; Brodd-Helgi was 12.

killings.evidence: Helgi var inni og heyrir stefnuna og hleypur út síðan og leggur í gegnum Þormóð
killings.relation_detail: Neighbour and ally of Geitir; no kin.
killings.note: Dispute over a shared wood; killed while summoning Þórður at Hof.

killings.evidence: Féll þar fyrstur Birningur fyrir Blængi.
killings.relation_detail: Birningur was Bjarni's lookout/follower.
killings.note: Battle in Böðvarsdalur between Þorkell Geitisson's party (avenging Geitir) and Bjarni's party.

killings.evidence: Þorkell settist þá niður en Blængur sótti að Bjarna allfast í ákafa. Lýkur svo þeirra atgangi að Blængur fellur.
killings.relation_detail: Blængur Lýtingsson is the brother of Bjarni's mother Halla Lýtingsdóttir (maternal uncle).
killings.note: Blængur attacked Bjarni; kin-killing within the Hofsverjar/Krossvíkingar feud (cf. KL102 Bjarni > Geitir, also blood).

killings.evidence: Hann sprettur upp og hleypur að honum og hjó hann banahögg.
killings.relation_detail: Torfi was about to marry Halli's mother (not yet married, so no affinity).
killings.feud_name: Halli vs Torfi (mother's marriage)
killings.note: Torfi compared Halli to a sow; Halli also opposed the marriage as beneath the family.

killings.evidence: Og í því kom Eyjólfur á bak Böðvari og hjó hann banahögg
killings.relation_detail: No kin.
killings.avenges_person: Þorvarður (Svarfdælir kinsman killed in truce by Hrólfur gípa, ch4)
killings.note: They tell Ljótur 'að þeir hafa mannhefndir framdar eftir frændur þeirra'. Böðvar is brother of Hrólfur gípa and Halli. Avenged killing is not in the dataset.

killings.evidence: Hafði Bessi vegið Sigmund áður. Þar féll Böðvar, Bessi, Hávarður austmaður ... og Sigmundur.
killings.relation_detail: No kin.
killings.note: Sigmundur had alerted the attackers; Bessi killed him in the ambush before Björn killed Bessi (KL091).

killings.evidence: Hann hafði engi orð við Eyvind og veitti þegar aðgöngu. ... Eyvindur var þá fallinn og allir hans menn.
killings.relation_detail: Eyvindur is the brother of Sámur and cousin of Einar (KL079); no tie to Hrafnkell.
killings.avenges_person: Hrafnkell's own humiliation by Sámur and the Þjóstarssynir (no killing)
killings.note: Hrafnkell led 18 men; individual blows not described. A maid's taunt ('að hefnd væri í honum') prompts the attack.
